meta_data.base_class: get the working hours of a specific <public venue> in a given location - these venues all have fixed opening schedules and similar management structures.

tool_template.name: <class>_working_hours.get
tool_template.description: Get the working hours of a <class> in a specific location.

season.description: The season during which the <class>'s working hours are needed.

show_break_times.description: If true, includes any mid-day closure or break periods within the <class>'s daily working hours.

include_partial_closures.description: Indicates whether to include information about partial closures of certain areas or sections within the <class>.

include_additional_notes.description: If true, includes supplementary notes such as 'last entry time' for the <class>.
